about: Sensitivities (IND-B3 §2a). Values are computed from register inputs; while the inputs are pending, the value is null.
footer: Not a forecast. Not additive across cards.

entries.label: Mix shift since March at the June deposit base
entries.basis_note: Money moved from CASA to term deposits. Restoring the March CASA ratio with new CASA money instead needs (D06 x N01 - D01) / (1 - D06). Add the derivation to IND-D1 v1.1 before display.
entries.caveats: Not a forecast. Not additive across cards.

entries.label: Annual interest cost of that mix, pre-tax, approximate
entries.formula: low: S03 x (D09 - N11); high: S03 x (D09 - D10)
entries.basis_note: Low end: the lost CASA was all savings. High end: the lost CASA was in today's CA:SA mix. Q1 average costs applied to 30 Jun balances. Add the derivation to IND-D1 v1.1 before display.
